subject: dark_willow_bedlam
evidence: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。

context.description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。

subject: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
evidence: 最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。

context.description_en: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手的伙伴在%duration_tooltip%秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为%min_range%。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
notes_en: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.
notes_zh: 可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。

subject: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
evidence: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。

context.description_en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
context.description_zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

subject: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
evidence: The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies.

context.description_en: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
context.description_zh: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留%pause_duration%秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
notes_en: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
notes_zh: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。

subject: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
evidence: After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
notes_en: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
notes_zh: 脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。

scepter_loc.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
scepter_loc.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

subject: pudge_meat_hook
evidence: Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。

context.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

subject: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
evidence: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。

subject: treant_natures_guise
evidence: Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds.
While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.
自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。

context.description_en: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
context.description_zh: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得隐身状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
notes_en: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.
notes_zh: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。

subject: magnataur_skewer
evidence: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

context.description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
notes_en: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

shard_loc.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
shard_loc.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

subject: pangolier_gyroshell
evidence: When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn.

context.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

subject: hoodwink_scurry
evidence: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。

context.description_en: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
context.description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。

subject: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
evidence: This ability will destroy trees.
该技能可以摧毁树木。

context.description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
context.description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
notes_en: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

subject: windrunner_powershot
evidence: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。
强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
notes_en: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

subject: lina_light_strike_array
evidence: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.
光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
context.description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
notes_en: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

subject: enigma_midnight_pulse
evidence: This ability destroys trees in its area.
此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
context.description_zh: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

subject: warlock_rain_of_chaos
evidence: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
context.description_zh: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

subject: beastmaster_wild_axes
evidence: This ability destroys trees.
此技能将摧毁树木。

context.description_en: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
context.description_zh: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁树木。

shard_loc.en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard_loc.zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

subject: leshrac_split_earth
evidence: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
notes_en: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.
notes_zh: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过%delay%秒延迟后生效。

shard_loc.en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard_loc.zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复%shard_max_count%次，重复间隔为%shard_secondary_delay%秒。每次作用范围增加%shard_radius_increase%。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

subject: batrider_firefly
evidence: The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider.
飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。

context.description_en: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
context.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
notes_en: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
notes_zh: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。

subject: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
evidence: The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。

context.description_en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
context.description_zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
notes_en: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.
notes_zh: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。

subject: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
evidence: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.
落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

context.description_en: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
notes_en: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.
notes_zh: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

subject: slark_pounce
evidence: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

context.description_en: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
context.description_zh: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
notes_en: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
notes_zh: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。

scepter_loc.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

subject: shredder_whirling_death
evidence: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area.
Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。
如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。

context.description_en: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
context.description_zh: 伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。如果敌方英雄受到了作用，他的主属性将在短时间内降低少许。如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。

subject: shredder_chakram
evidence: The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.
锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。

context.description_en: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
context.description_zh: 伐木机将主锯刃射向目标区域，锯刃会高速旋转，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被降低。锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。在发射锯刃后伐木机将无法攻击，同时会持续消耗魔法。
notes_en: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.
notes_zh: 如果伐木机魔法不足或移动超过%break_distance%距离，锯齿飞轮将会飞回。

subject: shredder_exposure_therapy
evidence: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
伐木机只要摧毁一棵树就会获得魔法。

context.description_en: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
context.description_zh: 伐木机只要摧毁一棵树就会获得魔法。

subject: techies_suicide
evidence: This ability destroys trees.
此技能将摧毁树木。

context.description_en: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
context.description_zh: 工程师冲到敌人中间，在相遇时引爆炸药，造成大量范围伤害，并眩晕敌人。引爆时会对工程师造成当前生命值一定百分比的非致死伤害。
notes_en: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.
notes_zh: 工程师在此次爆炸中受到的自身伤害为纯粹伤害，而且不会致死。
此技能将摧毁树木。

subject: monkey_king_tree_dance
evidence: If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s.
如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

subject: hoodwink_bushwhack
evidence: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.

context.description_en: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
context.description_zh: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成眩晕。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
notes_en: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.
notes_zh: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

evidence: Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle.

context.description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
context.description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

subject: kez_echo_slash
evidence: Destroys trees.
会摧毁树木。

context.description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
